text: Implemented the complete workflow ingest slice. Added shared ResponseBlockSource, CompositeResponseBlockSource, and ResponseBlockDatasetBackend with exact global-time/voxel order preservation. Added JVM NiftiResponseBlockSource positional reads and explicit NiftiStagingCache for metadata-keyed, reusable, atomic .nii.gz staging with partial cleanup. Added pure BidsStudyCompiler with aggregate CatalogCompileReport; deterministic subject/session/task/acquisition/run/echo/space/resolution/pipeline grouping; TR/events/confounds/mask joins; exact header geometry checks; participant/covariate records; persistent artifact references; single/intersection mask plans. Added BidsStudyCompilerJvm restricted to selected BOLD and mask headers, plus FirstLevelUnitSource to materialize masks and open composite run sources only at the JVM execution boundary. Evidence: realistic JVM fixture compiles 2 subjects x 2 runs including compressed/header-only BOLD data; pure tests cover aggregate missing header/TR/events/confounds/mask failures and run grouping; block tests cover arbitrary ordering and exact mask intersection. Verification: datasetJVM/test 54/54, datasetJS/test 37/37, fmriWorkflowJVM/test 13/13, fmriWorkflowJS/test 11/11; scoped diff check, trailing whitespace, platform-boundary, and reverse-dependency scans clean.
